ground_truth.cause: In batch, cache-warmer-fill inserts non-expiring warm:* keys into Redis in datastore, then sets maxmemory to 128mb. Redis uses noeviction; its filled keyspace exceeds that budget, so writes from cache-warmer and shop cart are rejected with OOM.
ground_truth.impact: The cause is Redis memory pressure in datastore, driven by batch writers. Cart writes fail and frontend returns errors downstream; payment and PostgreSQL/recommendation are not causal components.
ground_truth.mitigation: Stop or bound the batch warmer producers, safely remove their disposable warm:* keyspace and restore a viable memory budget (baseline 256mb) with verified headroom. Add bounded retention/TTL for continuing warmers. Verify Redis writes, cart and frontend recover. Do not indiscriminately flush unrelated data or only restart cart.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
